svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 700 mm of 20 mm round bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind a point 30 mm long on one end, about 4 mm across the tip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chamfer the top edge 2 mm so a sledge does not mushroom it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint a ring 500 mm from the tip: drive to this ring, which

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the exposed part (or use galvanized bar).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: driven upright 900 mm apart, one each side of the crack,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on a line square to it. Each carries a clamp block with its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a level on the pin shows it upright within 2 degrees.
